_doctrine: THE COMMONS LEDGER — sources. The standing fourth question ('whose knowledge is this pressed from, and does the walk return it or enclose it?') made into data, beside the dig ledger. Each source names WHOSE knowledge an artifact's form was pressed from. Kinds: named (a credited individual), collective (the unnamed makers — the heart of the commons argument), mathematical (a result that belongs to everyone/no one), nature (a form pressed from the non-human world), institutional (a named organization). 'return': credited = the walk names it; anonymous = the walk uses the form but the makers stay nameless (the debt the ledger surfaces); commons = already common by nature. Mine with tools/build_commons_ledger.py.
